item.title: Koha vs Evergreen vs FOLIO in 2026: Choosing an Open-Source Library System That Survives Year Three
item.description: Most library system comparisons are written by people who have installed the software once, on a laptop, with a demo dataset. That is not where library systems fail. They fail in year three, when your consortium has 1.2 million bibliographic records, 40 000 active patrons, a nightly MARC import from three vendors, and a circulation desk that cannot be offline for a Saturday.
